title: Japanese Noodle Soup
description: A comforting and flavorful Japanese noodle soup made with narutomaki and mildly seasoned ingredients.
instructions: Bring the mildly seasoned broth and water to a boil in a large saucepan.
Reduce the heat to a simmer.
Add the narutomaki to the saucepan and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the noodles to the saucepan and cook according to the package instructions.
Serve the noodle soup hot, garnished with additional narutomaki if desired.
